verdict.rationale: mParticle's first-party IDSync docs describe an identity resolution framework that creates a unified view of customers. They also say it gives visibility into, and control over, known and anonymous user identities across apps and platforms, which covers the core of the story. The configurability of the rules is only implied by 'control over' and 'policy', with no detail on how rules are set. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable identity strategies or matching-rule priorities, concrete anonymous-to-known merge behavior across devices, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, anonymous and known activity stitches into one customer profile across devices, with documented and configurable identity-resolution rules

citations.quote: IDSync is mParticle's identity resolution framework, enabling you to create a unified view of your customers, with improved data governance, policy, and security.
IDSync gives visibility into, and control over, the management of known and anonymous user identities across apps and platforms.
